_comment: Custom domains FDM serves for a platform app regardless of what the owner declared.
app name -> component name ('*' matches every component) -> the domains to serve.
The listed domains replace the component's declared ones and attach to its first
routed port; that component's remaining ports serve no custom domain. Applied to the
resolved routes, so it is version-blind and never touches a raw spec.
These are platform-operated apps whose public domains FDM owns, not customer apps.
